async def parse_list(page):
    items = await page.query_selector_all('ul li')
    results = []
    for item in items:
        title = await item.query_selector_eval('a.title, div.title, h3', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        author = await item.query_selector_eval('span.author, div.author', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        date = await item.query_selector_eval('span.date, div.date', 'el => el.textContent.trim()')
        pdf_element = await item.query_selector('a[href$=".pdf"]')
        pdf_link = await pdf_element.get_attribute('href') if pdf_element else None
        results.append({'title': title, 'author': author, 'date': date, 'pdf_link': pdf_link})
    return results
